text:
Augustus III most likely bought Correggio's *Adoration of the Shepherds* (*Holy Night*) in 1746. It was part of the Duke of Modena's paintings that went to Dresden, and it is now in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister. The *Madonna of Saint George* came in the same Modena purchase, so my earlier answer wasn't wrong about the purchase, but *Holy Night* is the better-known work and the likelier one to be asked about. I'm going from memory and haven't checked a source.

CONFIDENCE: 72
